diagrams.evidence: Live-provider final review; inherited UI/UX verification. Native acceptance is bounded to recorded models, settings and minimum Research-route scope.

diagrams.title: 02 · Prompt to completion
diagrams.subtitle: Single-bot native path; numbered rows continue in order

nodes.title: 1 · Select and review
nodes.body: Bots → saved profile → fresh conversation.

nodes.title: 2 · Capture revision
nodes.body: Connection, model, effort, identity, instructions and memory.

nodes.title: 3 · Build context
nodes.body: Role + untrusted owner context + completed turns; Off omits note.

nodes.title: 4 · Acknowledge Send
nodes.body: Exact prompt and context-sharing acknowledgement.

nodes.title: 5 · Validate + lease
nodes.body: Reject stale revision, busy ownership or invalid bounds.

nodes.title: 6 · Resolve runtime
nodes.body: No silent model/provider fallback. Native credentials only.

nodes.title: 7 · Execute
nodes.body: API: HTTPS Responses. Codex: authenticated app-server child.

nodes.title: 8 · Accept events
nodes.body: Started / Delta / Completed; validate stream and termination.

nodes.title: 9 · Poll snapshot
nodes.body: 250 ms while busy; accepted text and accurate terminal status.

nodes.title: 10 · Release ownership
nodes.body: Abort/join or verified completion; release generation lease.

nodes.title: 11 · Follow-up context
nodes.body: Completed turns retained in memory; stopped/error → new conversation.

nodes.title: 12 · Sanitized record
nodes.body: Hashed request ID, categories and timings; no durable bot transcript.

diagrams.note: No general tool-action stage exists here. Simulation needs no remote authentication. Collaboration instead persists room snapshots. Partial text alone does not prove completion.
diagrams.evidence: Adapter/host regressions plus native API/Codex completion, streaming and follow-up. Corrected Codex file-store and saved-low recheck separately retained.

diagrams.title: 05 · Lifecycle and failure handling
diagrams.subtitle: Exact state vocabularies differ between host, bot UI and persisted rooms

nodes.title: Starting
nodes.body: Request admitted under lease.

nodes.title: Streaming
nodes.body: Accepted bounded Delta events accumulate partial text.

nodes.title: Completed
nodes.body: Explicit terminal AND successful transport settlement.

nodes.title: UI completed
nodes.body: Completed context may support follow-up.

nodes.title: Stop action
nodes.body: Cancel owned active generation.

nodes.title: Cancelling
nodes.body: Close ingress; abort/join; preserve accepted partial text.

nodes.title: Cancelled
nodes.body: Native cancellation settled; release lease.

nodes.title: UI stopped
nodes.body: New conversation; late/repeated Stop preserves terminal.

nodes.title: Transport / protocol error
nodes.body: Incomplete, timeout, limit, billing, auth or malformed stream.

nodes.title: Failed
nodes.body: Preserve partial text plus fixed reason; not completion.

nodes.title: UI error
nodes.body: No automatic retry/fallback. New conversation for recovery.

nodes.title: Queued → Running
nodes.body: Sequential stage progression.

nodes.title: Terminal variants
nodes.body: Completed / Failed / Cancelled / Partial.

nodes.title: Interrupted on restart
nodes.body: Only unfinished stored runs become Interrupted; terminal runs unchanged.

diagrams.note: Awaiting approval belongs to synthetic/foundation workflows, not this live machine. Journal cap128 and text/token/time limits remain. Local Stop cannot prove zero remote billing or server cancellation.
diagrams.evidence: Native cancel/recovery/UI terminal stability retained. Precise backend race ordering is controlled-regression evidence, not a screenshot claim. Historical failures remain failures.

diagrams.note: Roles/prompts are not enforced controls. A directory is not a sandbox. Runtime flags are not a full isolation audit. Prompt injection can influence text; schema validation does not establish truth.
diagrams.evidence: Closed-boundary/privacy regressions retained. This is source-based architecture documentation, not a complete security audit. See security.md for detailed evidence.
